item.title: Just me, html, a script and an editor
item.description:
monoblog has a new look and a new engine, or no engine.

Like monointerferenz the blog was based on Jekyll. But I wanted less. No dependencies, no deployment, no management. So here we are.
Simple, handwritten html files. Just a small script handles the rss feed, the tag system and the index page. It runs locally, gets not deployed.
Just me, a script and an editor.
